001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventFactor;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventIntel;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseFactorTooltip;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI.TooltipCreator;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
012
013public class SDRMacarioFactor extends BaseEventFactor {
014        
015        public SDRMacarioFactor() {
016        }
017
018        @Override
019        public boolean shouldShow(BaseEventIntel intel) {
020                return true;
021        }
022        
023        @Override
024        public TooltipCreator getMainRowTooltip(final BaseEventIntel intel) {
025                return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
026                        @Override
027                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
028                                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
029                                tooltip.addPara("The scheming of Dolos Macario slowly but surely advances Hector's victory "
030                                                + "in the struggle for control of the Sindrian Diktat.", 0f, h, "Dolos Macario");
031                                
032                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_gotInesisSupportForHectorNoMac")) {
033                                        tooltip.addPara("At your instigation, Faro Inesis is running a counter-intelligence operation "
034                                                        + "to thwart the machinations of Dolos Macrio.", 8f, h, "Faro Inesis");
035                                }
036                                else if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_gotInesisSupportForAntiMacario") && 
037                                                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_uploadedAskoniaCommsHackInesis")) {
038                                        tooltip.addPara("At your instigation, Faro Inesis is running a counter-intelligence operation "
039                                                        + "to specifically hinder and discredit Macrio.", 8f, h, "Faro Inesis");
040                                }
041                                
042                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_gotCadenAntiMacario")) {
043                                        tooltip.addPara("There are reports of unusual friction between the Lion's Guard and the internal "
044                                                        + "security ministry of the Sindrian Diktat. There have already been arrests and counter-purges "
045                                                        + "while the Askonian population suffers contradictory enforcement operations.", 8f, h, "unusual friction");
046                                }
047                        }
048                };
049        }
050
051        @Override
052        public String getProgressStr(BaseEventIntel intel) {
053//              if (getProgress(intel) <= 0) return "";
054                return super.getProgressStr(intel);
055        }
056        
057        @Override
058        public int getProgress(BaseEventIntel intel) {
059                
060                int _points = SDRPoints.MACARIO;
061                
062                if(Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_proHector")) {
063                        _points = SDRPoints.MACARIO_PRO_HECTOR;
064                }
065                
066                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_gotInesisSupportForHectorNoMac")) {
067                        _points += SDRPoints.INESIS;
068                }
069                else if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_gotInesisSupportForAntiMacario")) {
070                        int _mult = 1;
071                        if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_uploadedAskoniaCommsHackInesis")) {
072                                _mult = 2;
073                        }
074                        _points += SDRPoints.INESIS * _mult;
075                }
076                
077                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_gotCadenAntiMacario")) { 
078                        _points += SDRPoints.CADEN_RESENTMENT;
079                }
080                
081                
082                        
083                
084                
085                return _points;
086        }
087
088        @Override
089        public String getDesc(BaseEventIntel intel) {
090                return "The machinations of Dolos Macario";
091        }
092        
093        @Override
094        public Color getDescColor(BaseEventIntel intel) {
095                if (getProgress(intel) != 0) return Misc.getTextColor();
096                return Misc.getGrayColor();
097        }
098
099        
100}
